niche_preference_profile: This user most consistently prefers interfaces with strong, explicit hierarchy; content-rich screens that feel populated and useful; clear, prominent primary actions; cohesive grouped layouts with well-defined modules; and polished, modern styling that often uses contrast, depth, and expressive accents. They repeatedly reject empty, underpopulated, weakly structured, or visually generic screens. Their color preference is not stable across contexts, but they consistently favor whichever option feels more intentional, higher-contrast, and more visually resolved.

criteria.description: Prefers strong, explicit hierarchy with clearly tiered sections, grouped content, distinct labels, and obvious title-to-body-to-action progression.
Prefers populated, information-rich screens with visible items, complete sections, and meaningful content rather than sparse or empty layouts.
Prefers bold, explicit, easy-to-find primary actions and clearly presented controls over hidden, tiny, secondary, or ambiguous actions.
Prefers layouts with coherent grouping and structured modules—cards, sections, or integrated blocks that organize content clearly and avoid fragmented or noisy composition.
Prefers fewer competing elements, less ornamental distraction, and cleaner focus on the main content and actions rather than decorative clutter or split attention.
Prefers interfaces that feel modern, polished, branded, and visually expressive, with stronger personality, depth, and intentional styling rather than generic utility aesthetics.
